purpose: Reusable all-actor source factory/rest bounds and original body radius plan; source component selection/property/AI/name/static facts supplied. No actor class/map/weapon specialcases.
input: CharacterVisualConfig actual model/controller policy; original resolved PropertyState and AiTables; admitted source initial XYZ and degree rotation; actual source name/static84/owner identity. previous_flat is actual source prior producer byte.
output: Owned original rest mesh/relative/absolute source boxes; exact controller component bindings/count; original AI ID/type/IsPlayer; physical enabled/circular bool and group/category/mask scalar metadata; game-unit circular radius. No pointer-bearing body definition, fake physical receiver, NativeBody or live pose retained.

selection.explicit: Every nonempty unique explicit ID must exist in actual source controller library and map to source modular category node or actual nonmodular serialized controller instance. Unknown, duplicate, ambiguous/missing bindings reject atomically.
selection.substring: Matches exact controller IDs; empty matches reject; conflicts with explicit/default selection reject.
selection.modular: Requires explicit controller IDs, substring or authored defaults; no class/equipment fallback. Serialized defaults decoded by original modular descriptors; available category modules mapped to exact authored group nodes.
selection.defaults: Serialized modular defaults selected plus visible actual nonmodular controllers, matching source visual policy
selection.counts: expected_controller_count must match actual selected controller IDs; no silent omission
selection.rigid: Existing OriginalActorBounds source CalcMeshBox includes authored rigid instances independently of CharacterVisual.include_static_instances rendering flag, preserving current main body producer. Render-only rigid inclusion is not a physical shape selector.

source_rules.scale: Original base12/13/14 factor bits and resolved collision property16 via OriginalActorBounds source producer; no repeat scaling
source_rules.rest: calculate(...,nullptr) explicitly source factory/rest cache, initial admitted rotation/placement applied once. No animation sampling or perframe bbox recompute.
source_rules.ai: Resolved property1, source fallback8 for invalid index
source_rules.is_player: Original IsPlayer: nonzero type true only type1; type0 iff exact case-sensitive source name begins PlayerCharacter
source_rules.body: Stack-local dh2_character_body_config delegates source type/static/player precedence and enabled shape/filter/radius math. Temporary input/newphysical pointer never escapes returned plan.
source_rules.radius: For enabled circle only: exact definition.radius in physics units times100. Disabled/polygon report circularfalse and radius_game_units0; cannot silently use circular movement for polygon.

integration: Root may bind the owned boxes to sole actual source physical owner and use radius_game_units for admitted circle-only controller setup. Preserve cached bounds across animation; use source position update to translate them. Native allocation, PF publication and source live lifecycle remain separate components.
dependencies: Existing original_actor_bounds/modular_defaults/recovered BRES/scene/skinning/math/properties/AI and dh2_character_body_config; no additional body backend or retained VM hierarchy for planning.
